hypothesis: The selected negative channel-gain formula, prospectively mapped from the 9B model to the last two dense MLP layers of the specified 27B model, may alter correctness on these six fresh task families.
allProjections: not_applicable: first rule only defines MLP activation gains

population.selectionPopulation: none; candidate selected in WGSL before this screen
population.developmentPopulation: oracle reference and deliberately incorrect fixtures only; no model sampling

evaluation.formatPolicy: strict raw JSON or Python function; no Markdown extraction or output repair
evaluation.public: declared JSON schema or public Python example and language subset
evaluation.heldout: exact JSON answers or reserved Python behavioral cases; these are within-family checks, not independent tasks
evaluation.sealing: Seal exact bytes of all 24 outputs before any public or heldout scoring; no early stopping or reranking by outcomes
evaluation.selection: none; retain every request including truncations and errors
evaluation.decision: Descriptive paired task outcomes and exact pass counts only; no significance or broad cross-domain confirmation threshold
evaluation.truncation: Record termination reason and output tokens separately; cap hits remain in denominator

transform.scope: MLP activation channels only, 27B layers 62 and 63; original selected 9B layers 30 and 31 retained as sourceCandidate
transform.derivation: same frozen negative rule derived independently from each task prompt; never reuse shader gain arrays
transform.firstToken: Base-cache first token uses unchanged base prefill logits; later decode applies gains
transform.reference: A removes exact instruction token span and retains stable nonempty framing; CPU exact-tokenizer qualification required before freeze
transform.controls: Same prompt and seed in all four conditions. Preserve magnitude and size for permuted gains; shuffled context statistics do not alter generation prompt.

diagnostics.policy: One prefill-only reset check on first task of each domain; separate from 24 generated responses and quality denominator

costs.executionLimit: 24 generations, 3 prefill-only reset diagnostics, declared token cap; hardware resource guards and allocation pinned in runtime lock before execution
costs.accounting: Report cold load, preparation/statistics, per-request attributed E2E, physical stage, diagnostics, scoring, token counts, errors and truncations separately; do not call wall allocation active GPU time
costs.memory: Report measured allocations and limits; unknown isolated peaks remain unknown

omissions.adapter: not included in this small exploratory screen; shader-trained adapter is not a cross-domain specialization comparator
omissions.computeMatchedSampling: not included; no efficiency superiority claim
omissions.rePrefill: not included; this screen does not compare cache arms
omissions.randomZ: not included; retained controls are base, shuffled context, permuted gain

freezeRequirements: Root review of runtime/settings and exact task bytes
Existing model/tokenizer/template/runtime/device/precision identity pinned in source lock; no model substitution
CPU exact tokenizer boundary qualification for all six prompts
Focused CPU reference/wrong-answer oracle tests pass

claimLimits: Six task families cannot establish broad arithmetic, coding, writing or general capability.
Screen tasks were authored after WGSL selection, not used to tune the candidate. Prior model-training exposure is unknown.
Oracle authors necessarily know expected answers; generator receives task prompts/public examples only.
No result changes the original shader protocol, confirmation population or joint decision.
This screen changes both model and task domains relative to WGSL selection. It evaluates a mapped rule on 27B; it cannot isolate cross-domain transfer on the original 9B model.

methodology.borrowed: Bounded matched quick test, immutable candidate/source identity, sealed outputs, explicit full cost, preserve failures, separate evidence from next hypothesis.
methodology.notBorrowed: No enwiki9 execution, corpus, compression thresholds, queue or reopening.

architectureMapping.rule: Map the source rule to the last two dense SiLU MLP layers of this distinct model; preserve beta, clip, epsilon and reference A. This is not the literal selected 9B candidate or a same-model transfer confirmation.

freezeNote: Filename retains draft history; this version is frozen before any27B generation. Runtime lock must bind these exact bytes before execution.
executionContext: Owner-authorized parallel execution on Jupiter with existing9Bconfirmation; overlapping timing is contended and descriptive. All prompts fit within previouslyqualified256-token prefill window; this specific split/gain path is being measured, not assumed qualified.
timingBatch: First complete task/four conditions is measured for remaining-work ETA only; no public/heldout scores opened before all24 outputs are sealed.
